questions.question_english: What is the primary purpose of Notification Centres in modern desktop and mobile operating systems?

To regulate background application execution schedules and CPU allocations
To manage user credential storage, authorization tokens, and security keys

questions.explanation_english: Notification Centres in modern desktop and mobile operating systems serve as centralized management hubs for system communications. They consolidate alerts, incoming messages, application updates, and security reminders into a single organized display panel. This centralized approach enables users to review, interact with, or dismiss incoming notifications conveniently without interrupting ongoing background workflows or requiring individual applications to maintain continuous on-screen pop-up notifications across the active interface.

questions.question_english: What is the primary benefit of file compression formats such as ZIP or RAR?
options_english: They prevent non-administrative system users from deleting protected data files permanently.
They translate document contents and structural metadata automatically into target languages.

questions.explanation_english: File compression formats such as ZIP and RAR utilize encoding algorithms to compress raw data files into smaller total bit counts. By identifying and eliminating internal data redundancies, compression significantly reduces the physical storage footprint on hard drives and storage volumes. Furthermore, smaller file sizes facilitate faster network file transfers, reduced bandwidth consumption during downloads, and efficient consolidation of multiple individual files into a single structured archive container.

questions.question_english: Which of the following describes a root directory?
options_english: A temporary system directory generated automatically inside the desktop Recycle Bin container.
A hidden system metadata file that stores encrypted user authentication and password hashes.
The default local directory created during the installation of security antivirus applications.
The top-level folder in a file system hierarchy from which all subdirectories originate.
questions.explanation_english: The top-level folder in a file system hierarchy from which all subdirectories originate. In computer file systems, the root directory represents the top-most starting node in an inverted tree file hierarchy. Represented by a backslash (\) in Windows (such as C:\) or a forward slash (/) in Unix-like systems, all other folders, subdirectories, and files branch outward from this foundational root level. It serves as the primary starting point for absolute pathing and directory traversal.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। फ़ाइल प्रणाली पदानुक्रम में शीर्ष-स्तरीय फ़ोल्डर जिसे रूट निर्देशिका कहा जाता है, सभी उपनिर्देशिकाओं का मूल बिंदु होता है। कंप्यूटर फ़ाइल प्रणालियों में, रूट निर्देशिका एक उल्टे पेड़ फ़ाइल पदानुक्रम में सबसे ऊपर का प्रारंभिक नोड होती है। इसे Windows में बैकस्लैश (\) द्वारा और Unix जैसे सिस्टम में फॉरवर्ड स्लैश (/) द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है। सभी अन्य फ़ोल्डर, उपनिर्देशिकाएँ, और फ़ाइलें इस मूल स्तर से बाहर शाखा बनाती हैं। यह पूर्ण पथ और निर्देशिका यात्रा के लिए प्राथमिक प्रारंभिक बिंदु के रूप में कार्य करता है।
key_facts: The root directory is the top-level folder in a file system.
In Windows, it is represented by a backslash (\), while in Unix-like systems, it is represented by a forward slash (/).
All subdirectories and files branch from the root directory.
Printed answer key: (D) The top-level folder in a file system hierarchy

questions.question_english: What is the main characteristic of proprietary software?
options_english: It is made available to all educational and commercial institutions without licensing fees or restrictions.
Its source code is private and licensed under usage terms restricted by the copyright owner.
It requires end users to alter and compile its internal programming source code before execution.

questions.question_english: Which of the following characters is generally prohibited in Windows file naming conventions?

Characters such as the asterisk (*), question mark (?), forward slash (/), backslash (\), colon (:), and quotation marks are reserved for system wildcards and path separators. Conversely, standard special symbols such as underscores (_), hyphens (-), and hash signs (#) are permitted within standard file and folder names.
